title: Graph plugin nodes resolve inside known plugin roots instead of dlopening last_path

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphLoadOptions gains scan_mode, load_plugins and plugin_roots fields with safe defaults; the SDK's graph loading contract is unchanged for callers and no capability key is added.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp bake loads graphs with plugin nodes as placeholders; no timeline verb, flag or handler changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: This hardens how a .pulpgraph file's plugin nodes are resolved before loading and adds no musician-facing control or operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No capability key or design-time manifest is added or changed.
